frequency_question: How often do proposed high-impact regulatory fee increases proceed from proposal to published final rule within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant proposed rules involving fee hikes published in the Federal Register; excludes minor technical amendments and purely voluntary guidelines.
